plan_consistency: Scope and missing-measurement claims are coherent; implementation-specific omissions above must be closed and checked after handoff.

recommendations.topic: Keep one coherent locked snapshot without nested run lock
recommendations.fact: Public runtime status acquires engine _run_lock; flock is acquired on a fresh fd each time. A wrapper that holds the same lock and then invokes that API risks blocking itself. A public status call followed by unlocked raw reads does not provide the selected atomic snapshot.
recommendations.recommendation: Acquire original lock once around existing _load, mandatory wrapper guard, native completed-run replay/publication checks and all input reads; do not reacquire it through public status. Keep same exact registered interpreter.
recommendations.suggested_test: Completed fixture reconciliation terminates without nested-lock blocking; rejected paused/unpublished/foreign-interpreter runtime produces no success report.

recommendations.topic: Explicit sanitized projection for reports and errors
recommendations.fact: Runtime view includes delivery/delegation data, broker records retain arguments and output, and the original cost parser permits additional keys inside usage-detail objects. Copying a whole source dict can publish sensitive text.
recommendations.recommendation: Construct output fields individually with validated numeric values, bounded identifiers and hashes. Never include complete request/response/status/delivery/tool args/streams or raw detail groups. Use fixed error text without raw input values.
recommendations.suggested_test: Add sentinel strings to permissible unknown usage-detail fields and known private request/response/output fields; require absence from stdout, stderr and serialized result.

recommendations.topic: Semantic usage reconciliation beyond existing digest replay
recommendations.fact: Engine _response checks RAW hashes and receipt.settled==ledger record, but does not explicitly compare response usage and detail groups with the settlement record. Price ledger independently validates its own settlement.
recommendations.recommendation: Extract the exact three numeric usage fields and the same two detail groups as original settlement; reject mismatch against receipt and ledger rather than trusting a native replay status or one copied total. Reject bool, negative, inconsistent input+output and cache/reasoning bounds.
recommendations.suggested_test: Independently corrupt response usage, receipt settlement, ledger record, role/model/effort and journal membership; each discrepancy rejects reconciliation.

recommendations.topic: Preserve conservative original per-request pricing and missing detail semantics
recommendations.fact: Original pricing aliases cached_tokens/cache_read_tokens, rejects disagreement, prices unclassified input at maximum declared input rate and applies integer ceil per request. Missing detail groups in final D119 synthetic responses are absent, not authenticated zero usage.
recommendations.recommendation: Use frozen profile, recalculate each request with original formula, compare held_cost_micro_usd, sum already-rounded costs. Publish observed classification and coverage separately; incomplete aggregate cache/reasoning counts remain unknown. Never label unclassified input uncached or add reasoning/cache to total again.
recommendations.suggested_test: A fractional-price multi-request example distinguishes sum(ceil(each)) from ceil(sum); exercise aliases, partial absent groups, cache-write/read/uncached bounds and reasoning subset.

recommendations.topic: Validate local time values and distinguish clock domains
recommendations.fact: Send receipt timestamps are time.monotonic_ns; ledger send markers are time.time_ns. Tool receipt contains separate sandbox duration and enclosing host_elapsed_seconds. Native digest/replay bindings do not themselves provide semantic clock validation or boot identity.
recommendations.recommendation: Require exact integer positive ns and ended>=started; reject bool, nonfinite, negative sandbox/host seconds. Sum local send, sandbox and host measures independently. Keep no clock/boot identity, global union and W explicit missing.
recommendations.suggested_test: Reject swapped/negative/bool timestamps and negative/bool/nonfinite durations; do not compare wall ns with monotonic ns or derive W from extrema.

recommendations.topic: Report exact local journal coverage without claiming full activity coverage
recommendations.fact: The same transport worker measures count_input but only successful sends receive model receipts. Tool duration does not include all replay/merge/human/provider work. D119 has one persistent ledger and multi-epoch request/role counters.
recommendations.recommendation: Require exact request/response/receipt/ledger/timeline sets, all role turn counters and broker global tool ordinals/reservations/receipts. Label completeness only for observed local send/tool journals. Input counting duration, W, H, remote activity and study cost stay missing.
recommendations.suggested_test: Extra/missing/orphan journals, duplicate IDs or counters reject; multi-epoch A/B/C fixtures preserve global counts; all reports retain explicit missing measurements and formal=false.
